artifacts.summary: KEEP disposition recorded as ADR-009; the archive's counts made generated and gate-enforced, its inventory, taxonomy, subdirectory coverage and provenance repaired, and a publication-facing framing added.

completion_data.completion_summary: Decided and recorded the disposition of FormalSystem/Boneyard/ as KEEP, in ADR-009: cutting was unavailable (96 citing files outside the archive, including the published LaTeX and 45 live .lean docstrings) and splitting would have traded ADR-005's single-archive invariant for ~2% of the archive's lines while preferentially deleting refuted routes. Then repaired what shipped badly about it: the inventory generator is now archive-aware, so the archive's counts are generated and INV-gated instead of three mutually disagreeing hand-typed figures; the Directory Inventory is a generated 40-row block with no phantom or missing entries; all 39 subtrees have a README, a taxonomy classification and a subdirectory-detail entry; provenance is re-keyed from repository-internal task numbers to 37 date-plus-commit-SHA rows; all 168 archived files now carry #exit and an archival banner; and the README opens with the two machine-checked facts (zero .olean under any Boneyard path, zero structural sorry in the live tree) that neutralize its size. Nothing was deleted: 168 archived files before and after, and the full gate plus lake build are green.

metadata.compliance_note: The plan commits to NO new Lean declarations -- its Lean Challenge Statements section declares the identifier set empty, matching an empty set of identifier-shaped Goals bullets. There is therefore no declaration list to spot-check against Theories/. Coverage was instead verified structurally: every one of the 40 top-level archive entries has exactly one generated inventory row and one taxonomy row, checked in both directions, and all 39 subtrees appear under both the taxonomy and the subdirectory details.
metadata.concurrency_caveat: A separate session executed the WorldHistory -> ConvexHistory rename (task 552) in the same working tree throughout. The Phase 1 baseline gate carried one pre-existing failure (C12) from that work, and transient C5/C11/C20/INV findings appeared and cleared as it progressed; by Phase 6 the gate was fully green. One unguarded lake build launched by this task's gate collided with their guarded build and was killed immediately; every subsequent build went through lake-build-guard.sh detached. Every commit here used git-commit-scoped.sh with an explicit pathspec, but the sweep was not symmetric: this task's Phase 9 edits to FormalSystem/FormalSystem.lean and FormalSystem/README.md were committed by their session in b9fd6f15c. The content is correct and present; only the attribution is off.
